gen-dafont-neon-gf-nokora: Glowing and vibrant: Neon keeps a steady technical pen line around tall lowercase, while Nokora sets a thick, dark lowercase stripe. Neon earns its keep when it is big and short.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Glowing Neon keeps every curve at full width, with no thinning at the shoulders and tall, stamped metal lowercase. Noto Kufi Arabic is the quiet partner, a modern sans with an open, welcoming gap in the c.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Not one hairline anywhere in Neon, even in its lowercase a. Neon is all glow and stamped metal height, while Noto Sans Adlam, a contemporary sans, keeps its curve endings well apart.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-h: Neon runs on monoline strokes, glowing and tall like stamped metal, with open spacing throughout. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs points its tips outward and stands tall, while Neon loses its glow if made small.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Vibrant Neon traces its tall lowercase in a single width, like an outline, while Noto Sans Armenian stays approachable underneath. Outline up top, open round forms below: they fit together easily.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Neon glows, with lines that hold their thickness from end to end. Neon is best loud and tall, while Noto Sans Avestan is best quiet, with a pronounced x-height.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Neon has no stroke contrast at all, just glowing letters in a single unbroken width. And Noto Sans Bamum, a modern sans with big open counters, feels like daylight beside it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-batak: Pure glow, stamped metal tall, one steady stroke weight: that's Neon. Noto Sans Batak, a sans with a wide e and towering lowercase, would read comfortably down a whole page.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Neon gives its diagonals and verticals equal muscle, so every glowing letter looks stamped from tall metal. And Noto Sans Buginese, with open letter mouths and short ascenders, is the quiet foil.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: A constant glowing outline you can trace with a finger: that's Neon. Noto Sans Cherokee, an approachable sans-serif with short stalks and a wide e, would carry paragraph after paragraph without tiring.
